title: Cape Family Boat Rental
specs: Fleet includes Bayliner, Berkshire, Hurricane and more

Anyone born on or after January 1, 1988 must have completed a NASBLA approved boating education course or equivalent and have boating education ID and photo ID to operate a vessel with motor 10 HP or more in Florida
Florida visitors must comply with boating safety education requirements or show proof of equivalent course
Visitors may obtain a temporary certificate valid for 90 days to operate boats
If fishing, a Florida fishing license is required
includes: Captains Meeting prior to leaving the dock
blurb: Guests rent high quality boats such as deck boats, fishing boats, and pontoons to explore the waters of Southwest Florida. A captain's meeting is conducted prior to leaving the dock. Optional insurance is available for damage coverage.
extraNote: $150 deposit required at time of booking, applied to rental upon check-in · Guests financially responsible for damages not noted before leaving dock and for damage caused during rental · Alcohol consumption while operating vessel is subject to laws and fines; designated driver recommended and must be listed as additional operator
